public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
HUMAIN is a sovereign-wealth-backed AI & Software company at the PIF stage, having capitalized $40B+ in total raised. The identified comp universe spans 9 firms across AI & Software (1 public, 8 private), including Palantir (PLTR), Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition.

The peer-median method proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow comparables. Of 12 same-sector peers identified, none met simultaneous filters for stage alignment, adjacent-stage proximity, or similar valuation tier—a minimum of 3 datapoints was required to execute this triangulation. Falling back to an all-sector median would introduce material methodological error given HUMAIN's distinctive capitalization and governance structure relative to typical AI & Software entrants.

The absence of stage-equivalent or tier-equivalent comps reflects HUMAIN's structural uniqueness within the private frontier-tech landscape. No valuation range can be responsibly derived from the available quantitative data. Resolution of valuation would require either: (1) identification of additional late-stage, sovereign-backed AI infrastructure peers; (2) application of DCF or sum-of-the-parts frameworks tied to disclosed revenue or unit economics; or (3) precedent transaction analysis from comparable sovereign tech acquisitions or funding rounds. Current data does not support numerical synthesis.
